#### What would you like the SDK to do?

_A clear description of the behavior you want._

#### What are you trying to accomplish?

_The underlying goal. This often suggests a better shape for the API
than the one that first comes to mind._

#### Is there an API endpoint behind it?

_If this is about an endpoint the SDK doesn't cover yet, say which one.
Some are deliberately out of scope; see the README._
